dedupe_keys.name: phmsa pipeline operator annual report data mileage facilities commodities pipe material and installation dates us 2010 to present

description: Under 49 CFR Parts 191 and 195, operators of gas distribution, gas gathering, gas transmission, hazardous liquid, LNG and underground natural gas storage systems must file annual reports with PHMSA. According to the PHMSA metadata on the federal data catalogue, the reports include total pipeline mileage, facilities, commodities transported, miles by material and installation dates, and are used by safety researchers, government agencies, industry and PHMSA inspection planners. Files from 2010 to the present are offered as ZIP archives on the PHMSA site, updated yearly, and the listing was modified on 2 September 2026. A related PHMSA file holds mechanical fitting failure reports from gas distribution operators for 2011 to 2021; these are no longer required, and since 2021 the gas distribution annual report counts mechanical joint failures causing hazardous leaks instead. Data are available as free downloads and marked public domain. Coverage is the United States by operator and state. Caveats: data are operator-level aggregates, not geolocated segments, and the PHMSA pages refused automated reading on the day, so details come from the PHMSA metadata on data.gov. Simulation uses are pipe material and age profiles for fragility and ageing models and system mileage for normalising failure rates. Related records: data-phmsa-pipeline-incident-accident-data gives the incidents; data-npms-national-pipeline-mapping-system gives the pipeline map.
